name: "Show Stealer" Alexander Munroe
notes: Known from two roleplays posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 15 and 20 December 1998, both asking for comments, served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-rp-comments-apprectiated-1998-12-15.html and /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-rp-show-stealer-alexander-munroe-comments-appreciated-boy-am-i-1998-12-20.html. Billed "Show Stealer" Alexander Munroe, a toothpick-chewing Las Vegas native in baggy jeans and a gray sweatshirt, he walks out of the city past a "You are now leaving Las Vegas" sign and tells the AIWA that he has come to steal the show. In the second he sits at the counter of a Nevada diner on his way to Boston and, over coffee and steak and eggs, calls out the nine other men in the steel-cage Iron Man Death Match at Civil War on 31 December 1998, a match whose winner takes a title shot of his choice.
caption: A toothpick-chewing Las Vegas native who calls himself the Show Stealer and lists his nine cage opponents over coffee in a Nevada diner, in December 1998.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-rp-comments-apprectiated-1998-12-15.html and /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-rp-show-stealer-alexander-munroe-comments-appreciated-boy-am-i-1998-12-20.html (two sample roleplays posted to the newsgroup; the first has him announce himself to the AIWA, the second names his card there)
